A list of [[Disciple of Magic]] enemies from ''[[Final Fantasy XIV]]''. This includes only enemies from [[Final Fantasy XIV#Playable races|playable]] and similar races that use standardized animations and actions associated with their discipline. While other races may also hold disciplines, they are more prone to having unique actions defined by their race that distinguish them from standard disciplines. For those enemies, see [[Final Fantasy XIV enemies/Spoken|Spoken]]. ===[[Arcanist (Final Fantasy XIV)|Arcanist]]=== {{quote|text=A form of arcane art using esoteric calculations, arcanima was developed originally by the people of the south sea isles. After discovering a means of expressing natural phenomena in mathematical terms, they refined formulae into arcane geometries—precise patterns that allowed practitioners to weave aether into specific magical effect. This, in turn, bore the school of arcanima.|source=''[[Encyclopædia Eorzea: The World of Final Fantasy XIV]]'', p.104}} Includes [[Summoner (Final Fantasy XIV)|Summoners]] and [[Scholar (Final Fantasy XIV)|Scholars]]. {|class="article-table style="width: 100%;" |- !rowspan="2" width="25%"|Name !colspan="2"|BNpc !rowspan="2" width="5%"|Level !rowspan="2" width="5%"|HP !rowspan="2" width="5%"|Hitbox !rowspan="2" width="25%"|Abilities !rowspan="2" width="25%"|Spawn |- !width="5%"|Name !width="5%"|Base |- |{{LA|Celie|Bandit Leader}}

However, after the [[War of the Magi (Final Fantasy XIV)|War of the Magi]] triggered the [[Sixth Umbral Calamity]], the practice of magic was strictly forbidden. Though much knowledge was lost, some modest magicks, low in risk and easy to wield, have survived into the present day. The [[Gelmorra]]ns were the heirs to such small spells, and explored the arcane arts as best they could.
